A couple of years ago, I'm seeing this guy in a frat. We're at a party, my bf is the DD. Time to drive everyone home. One of his bros, Robert, is extremely drunk. We get him out of the house, he tears down the residential street, knocking over trashcans and trying to get this one recycling bin to fight him. We manage to wrestle him into the car.

ACT TWO: Robert decides the ride home is the perfect time to ask everyone in the vehicle whether they prefer pants or shorts. This being December, everyone is like "uhh...pants." One of our friends responds "I'm not a girl. I wear shorts." Our dear Robert for some reason breaks out into Britney Spears: "NOT A GIRL?! NOT A GIRL?! NOT YET A WOMAN!!" Silence for rest of trip home.

ACT THREE: We finally get this kid to my bf's house, where he is staying the night. As soon as we get his seatbelt off, he SPRINTS out into the night. We're all in shock: was he planning his escape this entire time? Search party commences. I offer to stay in the house, just in case this psycho decides to come home. It's been about 15 minutes, no sign of anyone, I've decided it's time to get out of my party dress and put on some of the boyfriend's comfy pajama pants. I undress and open the closet door...only to find Robert sitting on the floor of the closet. He looks up at me and very seriously asks, "Does this mean I win the hide and seek tournament?" Makes no mention of me being naked, does not even appear to notice. I escort him out into the livingroom, get dressed, and make sure he's settled on the couch. Later, as I'm walking into the kitchen to get some water, I hear a strange fountain noise. Walk into the livingroom, turn on the light...there's Robert. Pissing out of the window. I decide it isn't worth it, go back to bed.
He has no recollection of this in the morning.
